data_access.esa_archive: https://lpf.esac.esa.int/lpfsa/ : GWT single-page app, auth_method=cas (js/config.js); anonymous role exists but no documented scripted/TAP interface (tap_adql_interface_active=false; /lpf-tap/ 404). Raw Delta-g time series not obtained.
data_access.heasarc: https://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/FTP/lpf/data/ : public, downloads work, but it is the NASA DRS (ST7) telemetry (1 Hz/10 Hz science + housekeeping, mostly mode Off during LTP runs); no LTP interferometric Delta-g -> not usable for a fm s^-2 floor.
data_access.used: published per-run S_Brown (13 runs + cold run) digitized from Armano et al. 2024 Fig. 3 (arXiv:2405.05207v3) + Table 1 temperatures
